promptLatex: Two lines intersect, forming four angles. One of them measures $63^{\circ}$. What is the measure, in degrees, of the angle directly opposite it?
hintLatex: The angle directly opposite shares only its vertex with the given one, with no ray in between.
Those two angles are vertical angles.
Vertical angles are congruent, so the opposite angle also measures $63$.
solutionLatex:
Two angles that share only a vertex, with no ray lying between them, are vertical angles.

The angle given and the angle directly opposite are exactly such a pair.

Vertical angles are congruent, so the opposite angle also measures $63$.
